archetypes.name: review-provenance
archetypes.rationale: Plan-review provenance now gates both design publish and implement preflight.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the metadata flow from Step 3 result env through design publish and implement preflight. Focus on zero-review edge cases, malformed metadata, and whether emergency paths still fail closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-flow
archetypes.rationale: Several Bash guards now alter terminal control flow before Gate C.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the modified shell scripts for Bash 3.2 compatibility, exit-code consistency, and safe temp-file handling. Pay special attention to panel-init-failed staging, scope-anchor creation, and stale design-log worktree cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: regression-surface
archetypes.rationale: This change spans Python validators, docs contracts, and shell harnesses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the new tests pin the intended behavior without overfitting to incidental output. Look for untested branches around failure reporting, numeric mechanical_churn normalization, and review metadata insertion before diff_lines. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
